proposals.statement:
theorem periodicFrom_trans_period (f : ℕ → Bool) (p q N M : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hN : PeriodicFrom f p N) (hM : PeriodicFrom f q M) : PeriodicFrom f q N := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: It makes the onset of a Bool sequence independent of which period reads it, so any proof of this node may fix p = 2^k without loss and every onset bound proved for one period transfers to all; two closed files carry it privately and cannot be cited.
proposals.disclaims: Says nothing about rule 30 or about any onset being small; it only makes the onset a well-defined quantity.

route.tactics:
intro n hn
  have hMp : M ≤ M * p := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right M hp
  have h1 := periodicFrom_mul f p N hN M (n + q) (by omega)
  have h2 := periodicFrom_mul f p N hN M n hn
  have h3 := hM (n + M * p) (by omega)
  rw [← h1, ← h2, ← h3]
  congr 1
  omega
